title: Labor Code, Division 2, Part 4, Chapter 4 (Relocations, Terminations, and Mass Layoffs) - Cal/WARN
verified_how: The LAB Div 2 tree shows 'CHAPTER 4. Relocations, Terminations, and Mass Layoffs 1400-1413', 'ARTICLE 1. General Cal/WARN Requirements 1400-1408'. §1401 was amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 229 (SB 617), effective 1 Jan 2026.
